notes.title: BUG FIX UPDATE - September 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/073e376de11eba379174845953f9429a32e1abee.png[/img]

Hello, fellow Estate Agents!

We’re excited to bring you the latest update, packed with bug fixes and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. Here’s a list of Bug Fixes addressed in this patch:

[b]Item Spawn Issue:[/b] We’ve resolved the bug causing problems with item spawns. You should now experience smoother item placement and acquisition.

[b]Dialogue Text Errors:[/b] The nonsensical characters and texts that appeared in dialogues have been corrected. Most conversations should now make perfect sense (but there will be some funny ones of course!)

[b]Floating Items:[/b] Fixed the issue where some items were floating in the air inexplicably. Items should now behave as expected in their designated locations.

[b]YukiHouse Purchase Error:[/b] We’ve addressed the error that prevented players from purchasing items at YukiHouse. The process should run smoothly now!

[b]Farm Items in Vehicles:[/b] The bug affecting the placement and retrieval of farm items from vehicles has been resolved. Manage your farm inventory with ease!

[b]House Item Count:[/b]  The issue with the number of items displayed inside houses has been fixed. The number should now accurately reflect the amount of furniture.

[b]Collider Bug in Stackable Furniture:[/b]  We’ve tackled the collider bug that affected stackable house furniture. Arrange your furniture without collision issues!

[b]Vehicle Disappearance:[/b] The problem of vehicles sometimes disappearing has been addressed. [i][b]Important Note:[/b] If you’re still encountering this issue, please send us your ‘save files’ via Discord so we can investigate further.[/i]

[b]Hotel PC UI Bug:[/b] The UI bug affecting the hotel PC has been resolved. Enjoy a seamless interface for all your hotel management needs.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. As always, we’re committed to improving your gaming experience, and we appreciate your patience as we work on these updates.

Happy gaming!

— KikiGames

notes.title: THIEVES UPDATE is rolling OUT NOW!
notes.content:
WARNING ALL CITIZENS! We’ve detected an increase in criminal activity in our beloved city. Please read carefully. 

The Utopia Police Department has received several reports of houses being assaulted by masked suspects. The victims claim that several pieces of furniture have been subtracted from their properties. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/3ded9aa23ae2487315bd2bf414364aa22ed91bde.gif[/img]

Important note: All the assaulted properties have a common point. They were all empty from renters by the time these robbers committed their crimes. Please, be extremely cautious and don’t leave your houses empty for a long period of time if you want to avoid these robberies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/4adc92d039121c931302de8a2812e3767f0ec238.gif[/img]

These robbers are known to be greedy. We managed to catch one of the suspects by reaching the place shortly after receiving the warning. We are sure that you can also interrupt their crimes if you reach your properties fast enough. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/917fdafdb9cabdde9e407f3bc4fcffb0a2e6a915.gif[/img]

We hope that this warning puts everyone under advice to minimize the amount of people affected. We will continue to update you through our channels at Discord! 

Thank you everyone, and take care! 


*Message from the Developer team:

Aside from the ‘Thieves System’, this update also brings a lot of bug fixes. We wanted to thank you all for helping us detect and correct these. If you experience any bugs or may have some questions, feel free to hop on our Discord server. We have dedicated channels to assist you in the best way possible! 

Thank you, and enjoy!

notes.title: TRAFFIC REGULATIONS UPDATE
notes.content:
Good day, people of Utopia, our beloved City! Chief of the Police Department here. 

I would love to take a bit of your time for a very important announcement.

Lately, we have been receiving a lot of reports from worried neighbours regarding the multiple traffic incidents that have been taking place in our beloved city by people who are performing reckless driving. This has led to a state of insecurity that our department can not tolerate. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/b55a19f90018709e8b41eb3b7ca43e2ada2cdca8.gif[/img]

Starting today, we will pursue this unacceptable behaviour with all our resources, to ensure that everyone who drives through our streets takes extreme caution and does not risk anyone’s security. 

From now on, every traffic incident will result in a fine of enough amount to make those uncivil drivers think twice before committing another fault.

[h3]For those involved in any upcoming traffic incident: [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/52ca649643e01c695d8ec15d66c3c901ddee2685.gif[/img]

Every time you hit another person’s car, this incident will be reported and the fine will be deducted directly from your account in a lapse of 3 days. WARNING! Every single crash will be reported and charged simultaneously at the end of those 3 days.

Infractors will be notified by email when the charges are made to their accounts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/789e04ddf3fe1d32837319e53e63f48f87bf6dff.gif[/img]

We hope that this new traffic regulation delivers much safer streets for our beloved Utopia. 

We will continue receiving your reports in our citizen’s office at [url=https://discord.gg/estateagent]Discord[/url]

Thank you everyone, and take care!

notes.title: LANDSCAPE UPDATE is HERE!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Estate Agents![/b]

We're excited to share our newest update for Estate Agent Simulator! With this update, we're diving deep into the art of landscape architecture, giving you the power to transform ordinary houses into stunning and luxurious cribs that fetch top dollar on the market. Get ready to unleash your creativity and elevate your properties to new heights!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/3d383a847f93e088c67b07bcade42befe16d456b.gif[/img]

[h2][b]What’s new on Estate Agent Simulator?[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Landscape Architecture:[/b][/h3]

Now, more than ever, the exterior of your properties will be just as important as the interior. With the introduction of landscape architecture, you'll have the ability to design breathtaking gardens that will make your houses irresistible to potential buyers or renters. Beautify your surroundings and watch as your properties become the talk of the town!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/2a5165b0a9eaa9c42d48d27d32fc0fbcd9b5b23b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/82cc776197352689034af77b6fb173b282179f1b.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Design your dream landscape: [/b][/h3]

We're committed to continuously improving the Estate Agent Simulator experience based on your feedback. You just have to update your game and get access to all these new features!

Get ready to unleash your inner landscape architect and take your properties to the next level! Stay tuned for the release of this exciting update, out NOW!

notes.title: Estate Agent Simulator: Dive into the World of Real Estate!
notes.content:
Join us for an immersive dive into the [b]"Estate Agent Simulator"[/b] - where you not only get to buy and sell properties but also witness the intriguing details of real estate negotiations and decisions.

[b]About the Game:[/b]

Step into the shoes of a real estate agent in the dynamic marketplace of Estate Agent Simulator. This game enables players to:

[b]Buy & Decorate: [/b]Get properties and spruce them up to increase their market value.

[b]Advertise & Earn: [/b]Promote houses for either rent or sale to bring in revenue.

[b]Construction Opportunities:[/b] Vacant lands aren't just empty plots; they're brimming with potential. Buy, and with the help of construction workers, build the house of your dreams.

[b]Client Negotiations:[/b] Engage with prospective clients, ensuring you strike the best deal. Be wary, though; not all clients are as honest as they seem.

[b]Rent Collection:[/b] When it's time to collect rent, you might either find a neatly packed envelope or some 
tenants who need a bit more...persuasion.

[b]Stay Updated with News Centre:[/b] The city is always evolving, and so are property values. Keep an eye on local news and rumours to get a competitive edge.

Don't miss out on this captivating real estate adventure where every decision you make impacts your real estate empire's growth! Come and test your skills – do you have what it takes to become the ultimate estate agent?

notes.title: Estate Agent Intro
notes.content:
Some features in the game:

Make home and office design.
Control your houses from your computer and tablet.
Buy, sell and rent houses.
Spend more easily thanks to the bank and credit system.
Build houses.
Improve your skills with the skill tree system.
Engage in dialogue and negotiate.
Travel.
Fight. 
Buy a car.
Visit your tenants to collect rent.
Have your car repaired, painted, modified. Don't forget to buy petrol. 
Start a family with your mate.
Sort your rubbish and use the recycling system.
Increase the value of the houses you own by cleaning them.
You will not go hungry thanks to the food and vending system.
Increase the value of houses by arranging the items you buy from the seller in the houses.
Multiply your money with entertainment and action venues.
When you advertise a house, its miniature comes to your office, you can put it anywhere you want in your office.
Follow the warehouse wars and beautify your home.
Talk to your neighbours and get information about the city.
Participate in the auction.
Ride your horse around the city.
Seek justice with the lawyer and lawsuit system.
Improve your relationship by watching films with your partner.
Travel by going to bus stops.
Beware of malicious people in the city, they can spoil your relationship with your mate.
Go to the club and have fun.
Earn XP by collecting trash.
Adopt dogs in the city.
